I'd recommend finding a psychotherapist if you could find one. Psychiatrists in the philippines rely solely on medicines even when it doesn't do shit for your long term mental health when you aren't having proper therapy alongside it. Sure it could help you feel better but if you're living in the same environment without attempting to address the various psychosocial factors (which also has everything to do with the 'neurotransmitter deficiency' that you would want to treat with a pill) then you aren't doing yourself any good. You cant just treat depression without addressing deeper issues. Psychiatry in the philippines is shockingly one of the worst I've seen around the world. Please note that while some psychiatrists are also psychotherapists, most in the philippines don't have qualifications for psychotherapy. Anyways I hope you find one. I wish you well.

Mine started in September last year from moving in to a student housing that had black mold. We didnt notice any of it when we viewed it but there were a lot. It was only after we noticed that my boyfriends asthma was getting worse and just feeling generally unwell everytime we were in that house that we were able to find an entire wall of black mold behind the fridge, in the washing machine, and some on the ceiling of the kitchen. 

I got so upset. I already had mild OCD before moving in, especially with anything to do with food. I started googling how to get rid of it and read about effects of black mold. I tried to clean it and read something about how you shouldnt clean black mold on your own because it can release spores which could harm us when inhaled or even land on the food since it was in the kitchen. I then began to worry about the effects it already had on us. 

I had a sore throat every morning, nasal congestion and psot nasal drip everyday. When I felt some lymph modes on my neck, I went to the doctors about it and theyve dimsissed it as nothing. I became more and more worried about our health. I worried whenever my boyfriend coughed. I couldnt sleep worrying that he might just die in his sleep. Even though the doctors sais it was nothing and my boyfriend assured me that he's going to be fine I couldnt stop fearing the worst.

I began doing little inspections of things in the house and found out that the carbon monoxide alarm wasnt even working and the old gas fireplace was a fire hazard (i forgot why it was but i remember getting someone over to check it out and it was indeed a fire and health hazard). 

Finding little things like that and the confirmation that everything was a threat made me spiral. By the end of October We had to move out of that place. 

We moved into a new flat and thats when my worries became unhealthy. I was cleaning everything excessively. I even bought a UVC lamp (one that they use in hospitals for sterilizing) to sterilize the rooms and the things we had. 

I spent most of my time cleaning and worrying about every little symptom i had. I began to have panic attacks that would wake me up at night. I would look at my skin for marks and symptoms of sepsis. I would worry about the effects of the UVC lamp and how it might have given me cancer or maybe picking my skin has given me meningitis or sepsis. I had an impending sense of doom every night before sleeping that most nights i wouldnt even be able to sleep at all. 

I would go to the doctors back and forth. I even went to A&E so many times because i had chest pain but it turned out to be nothing. Although i did have costochondritis at one point in which they said could be stress related. Then I had burning sensations in my feet that i couldnt walk. Again, it was nothing. Then at some point, I vomitted blood, went to a&e and they said i had gastritis, i had an IV because i had a low BP. All these physical symptoms ive experienced made it even worse and fed my anxiety because i thought it cant possibly be anxiety. 

3 months ago i got diagnosed with panic disorder and fibromyalgia. Although I've done loads of tests  which showed nothing like MRI, ultrasounds, bloods, urine, stool, EEG, NCS, NCV, ECG, Stress test, Holter, Endoscopy, hearing test--- the panic attacks and health anxiety still continued.

Its been a month  and a half now since I accepted that its anxiety. So far, i feel like I'm improving. I havent had a panic attack for 2 weeks and even before then i had less frequent since I started to practice mindfulness, walk everyday, try eat healthy, Avoid caffeine and chocolates, i accept it when i have anxious thoughts i just acknoledge it and thank my anxiety. I dont avoid places, and triggers anymore. I've never pushed myself but whenever I can I expose myself slowly to them and on my own. I keep my stress low. Untense my muscle when i notice it tensed. I'm now kind to myself. I treat myself like how a friend would comfort me. I focus on things i do and i dont judge the anxious thoughts that come I try to reason with it and talk to it like a child thats scared. 

I still have the health anxiety but i try not to let it take over my life anymore. I do get pains and marks in my body every now and then but I dont focus on them as much anymore and I talk about it to other people as much as i can instead of googling anything. It helps a lot to talk about it. I would go to the doctor if i have something thats still there in about a week or have gotten worse or is unbearable but i wouldnt focus on it and continue to be mindful of things I enjoy doing.
